product_one_liner.value: Nanonets provides AI agents that extract and validate document data and automate complex business workflows for enterprise operations teams.

employee_band.notes: Public employee-count sources report approximately 325–327 employees, placing it in this band.

eng_blog.notes: The Research section includes OCR-s training details and the OCR-3 engineering devlog covering token efficiency, mixture-of-experts architecture and distributed training. OCR-s author Souvik Mandal is a deep-learning engineer whose profile identifies him as the R&D lead for OCR-s, OCR2 and OCR3.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live posting is for Deep Learning Engineer in Bengaluru, with deep-learning, LLM/VLM, NLP and computer-vision responsibilities.

model_provider.value: Nanonets OCR-3; Nanonets-OCR-s, fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-VL-3B.
model_provider.notes: These are explicitly identified proprietary/product models and a disclosed base model; third-party integration logos alone are not treated as proof of production model usage.

compliance_certs.notes: Public claims: SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001:2022; the product page also names HIPAA and GDPR under enterprise-grade certifications. The homepage qualifies these as a HIPAA BAA available for enterprise plans and GDPR alignment, rather than independent HIPAA/GDPR certifications.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest disclosed round was announced March 12, 2024, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Enterprise Account Executive posting, Palo Alto, California.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Shubhra Mishra’s profile dates the start of her Vice President, Strategic Initiatives role at Nanonets to March 2026, within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These are publicly documented product integrations; this does not establish that Nanonets uses each internally as its own CRM or sales stack.
